overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the notice's posting date and time were recorded on the bulletin board, and the contracts were tabled rather than executed in executive session. The new minutes claim was declined.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board's meeting notice did not indicate the date and time it was posted.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board complied with its obligation to post notice and indicate the date and time of posting, we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board voted to execute two employment contracts in executive session rather than in open session.
allegations.key_passage: Our review of the minutes demonstrates that, following the October 17, 2016 executive session, the Board voted to delay further discussion of these two contracts.

allegations.summary: On further review, complainant alleged the Board created inaccurate meeting minutes, a claim not in the original complaint filed with the Board.
allegations.key_passage: Because this allegation was not contained in the original complaint filed with the Board, we decline to investigate it now.
